videos.title: My Pomodoro App
videos.description:
I have a custom productivity system and this little guy helps me log pomodoros 🍅 I used Genspark Design to build the whole mobile UI. Gave it my assets, walked through the screens I wanted, and it even suggested widgets and notifications I hadn't even thought of.
Check out the link in my bio to Genspark Design yourself!

videos.title: Onboard your employees to Cowork in 15 minutes with this system
videos.description: After watching several PMs struggle with his "Spectacular" spec-writing gem because it was calibrated entirely to how he worked, Daniel built an onboarding flow that connects your tools, maps your colleagues, and captures your voice in about 15 minutes. Now every Melio employee starts from the same baseline and customizes from there, rather than starting from scratch or giving up.
